title: Brought AI-assisted coding to Philips University
summary: I created a new Philips University course on coding with GitHub Copilot, covering daily productivity, technical debt and test writing; its announcement was seen by 4,103 people.
what_would_have_happened: Engineers would try Copilot on their own, without shared prompts for technical debt and testing.
the_call: Teach practical prompts for real work, including technical debt and tests.
what_i_did: Built the course, offered it through the corporate learning system and taught it.
what_changed: The announcement was seen by 4,103 people, the widest reach of any post in my record.
